meaning_fixes.reason: Source drops the 第一次 (First) prefix here (bare 防衛戦争), but book(4) is the exact book id already locked to 'First Defensive War' at dialogue_01111 (batch_01073, reviewed in review_01073.json), where the source spells it out in full (第一次防衛戦争). A book id is a link to one specific encyclopedia entry, so the same id occurring with an abbreviated Japanese reference confirms this is the same war, satisfying the orchestrator's rule to keep 'First Defensive War' when context clearly points to the same event. Resolves the translator's own flagged uncertainty in favor of the locked term.
